snippet.title: Horse Runner DX - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🦄 Play the Demo or get Horse Runner DX on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955320/Horse_Runner_DX/

Lead your herd. Survive the chaos. Add more and more horses to your wild herd, dodge obstacles, and dash through this action-packed arcade runner. Stack unique power-ups, master the trail, and push your limits in addictive high-score runs to climb the global leaderboard.

FEATURES:
- Herd-Building Mechanics: Collect horses as extra lives and stack power-ups.
- Pure 1-Button Arcade: Easy to learn, hard to master - pure SNES/Flash nostalgia.
- Retro Chiptune Beats: 6 brand new tracks (Robot Unicorn Attack vibes).
- Meta Progression: Complete challenges, unlock 20+ horses, climb the global leaderboard.
- Handheld Optimized: Runs great on Steam Deck with 60/90 FPS and low battery usage.

Developed by solo developer Mat (Mat Makes Games).
Available on PC (Windows, Linux, Steam Deck). Coming to Nintendo Switch soon!

---

STREAMER & CREATOR NOTE:
All music tracks are 100% human-composed, Content-ID free, and fully safe for Twitch streams and monetized YouTube gameplay.

Stay updated:
Official Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955320/Horse_Runner_DX/
Press Kit: https://impress.games/press-kit/mat-makes-games/horse-runner-dx

#HorseRunnerDX #IndieGame #Gaming #SteamDeck #PixelArt #Arcade
